column1: # Czech (cs) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` is short sample text inside a rendered preview tile;
#              it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Czech computing and typography vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation,
# string table or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Counts use count-neutral wording (`Počet slov: 21`), so no plural forms are needed.
